gizmo.title: Tūemi kohinga
gizmo.description: He tūemi āhua kāri mō roto i tētahi rārangi kohinga, me te kupu, te hono, me te pāpāho kōwhiri.

advanced.title: Ata tohu
advanced.description: Ata tohu e tohu ana i te kāri.

advanced.title: Pānga kauruku
advanced.description: Huri i te kauruku o te whakaahua ina arotahi te kaiwhakamahi.

advanced.title: Ngā Tūtohu
advanced.description: Rārangi tūtohu kua wehea ki te piko.

advanced.title: Kupu kē
advanced.description: Kupu kē e whakaahua ana i te hono.
